task:
A gross settlement of 4842 credits is reduced by 23%. The reduced figure includes a 39% fee measured on its fee-free base; remove that included fee by division. Then add 6% of the ORIGINAL gross settlement. What is the exact result? Do not round. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 25 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 9% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 9 credits, then discount the whole amount by 10%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 4% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 19 credits, then discount the whole amount by 14%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 12% surcharge, then subtract 5 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 17 credits, then discount the whole amount by 9%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 4 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 24 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 13% surcharge, then subtract 10 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 5 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 5% surcharge, then subtract 4 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 22 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
